text:
INVESTIGATIONS OF CHRONIC STABLE ANGINA (ANGINA PECTORIS)
- Resting ECG:
- Normal in 50% of patients
- ST depression
- May show Q wave of previous MI
- Exercise stress ECG: Positive test evidenced by ST depression ≥ 1
mm at the J point (planar or down sloping)
- Arrhythmias or fall in BP
- Sensitivity (68%); specificity (77%)

- Echocardiography:
- May show segmental hypokinesia or dyskinesia, severe infarcts
show global hypokinesia
